The frozen 10-pixel raster font atlas is derived from the Aileron Regular subset
embedded in Pillow 12.3.0 ImageFont.load_default(). It is the existing application's
default font, not a substitute typeface. The embedded font's copyright name field
states: "No Rights Reserved." Its author name field identifies Sora Sagano.

Original embedded font SHA-256:
69853909b940023570964e29cffe30da95aea8de3627736b5cd15ab30143169f

Pillow routines and rasterization-reference adaptations retain the accompanying
PILLOW-LICENSE.txt notices. The atlas records the Pillow/FreeType versions and is
regenerated only by the explicit local oracle script, never by a deployed service.
